create_image_processor: create a DeepseekVLHybridImageProcessor instance for preprocessing images for the DeepSeek VLM hybrid model
resize_image_to_square: resize a torch tensor image to a specified square size while preserving aspect ratio and enforcing minimum size
pad_image_to_square: pad a batch of torch tensor images to square dimensions using a configurable background color
preprocess_images_for_model: preprocess a list of images with resize, pad, rescale, and normalize to produce pixel_values and high_res_pixel_values tensors
standardize_image_processor_kwargs: standardize image processor kwargs by converting size dicts and normalizing mean and std values to tuples
